scopeDecision.decision: Derive business requirements only. Test scenarios, test cases and test data are not to be created for this document.

phases.name: Scope and identity
steps: Confirm title, version, release date, fingerprint and 16-page count
Confirm the 14 nested bookmarks
Record real-time vs non-real-time scope as an owned question (Q01)

phases.name: Chapter inventory
steps: Split the document into chapters from its bookmarks and verify each heading on its start page
Anchor each lesson to a page-local quote inside its chapter
Prove every content page belongs to a chapter

phases.name: ATL105 reconciliation
steps: Locate the Segment 151, Segment 152 and Table 049 Sub-Table 09 references in ATL105 2026-3 and 2026-4
Record every source conflict or gap as an owned question

phases.name: Dataset catalog extraction
steps: Re-match every DV, PI, PU, OF and OC field row against page text
Re-match every usage-matrix row and footnote
Record encoding conventions with their interpretation IDs

phases.name: Transaction-type context matrix
steps: Map each usage-matrix column to its direction and transaction types (310, 910, 920, 200)
Flag duplicated or ambiguous columns instead of resolving them

phases.name: Independent BR derivation
steps: Derive each BR from cited lessons, catalog rows or ATL105 references only
Cover every non-informational lesson, every dataset, every usage matrix, every ATL105 reference and every open question
Mark a BR blocked when it depends on an unresolved SME question
Declare how each BR is enforced by the draft validator, or why it cannot be checked from data

phases.name: TS, TC and TD chains
steps: Out of scope by user decision on 2026-10-30

phases.name: Lifecycle and specialized flows
steps: Express the 310 preauthorization, 910 qualification, 920 spend and 200 refund relationships documented by the source as lifecycle BRs
Do not invent linkage the source does not state

phases.name: Validator and mutation
steps: Prove every registered validator rule is reachable by at least one mutated input in the regression test
ATL105 wire serialization of Segment 151/152 is not demonstrated

phases.name: AI artifact intake
steps: Compare AI-produced Segment 151/152 artifacts against the BRs when a package is supplied

phases.name: Execution and certification
steps: Requires host execution and SME approval

guardrails: InComm Market Basket Data Format 2023-1 supplements ATL105 2026-3 and 2026-4 Segments 151/152; it does not replace either release.
Only BRs are derived; no test scenarios, test cases or test data are produced for this document.
A BR that depends on an unresolved SME question stays DRAFT_BLOCKED_PENDING_SME.
QE interpretations recorded on 2026-10-30 remain pending SME confirmation and are cited, not promoted.
Draft BRs stay out of independent Test Solution counts until SME approval.
No status is promoted without source evidence and a recorded SME decision.
